sentence: This project studies how neural networks learn, including ways to train them without backpropagation.
This project builds ways to protect tiny computers in devices from cyberattacks, using hardware features for memory management and tracing.
This project builds mathematical models and software that use imaging data to learn how genes are expressed in cells.
This project builds tools to find hidden patterns in complex data and uses them to improve language models.
This project studies how a high rainfall region of the atmosphere over the South Pacific changed, using elements preserved in coral cores.
This project studies how mosquito genetics, the gut microbiome and temperature affect a bacterium that can help control malaria.
This project studies quantum bits, including defect qubits in two-dimensional host materials, and maps quantum systems at low temperature.
This project builds computer vision tools that help monitor biodiversity across the globe using data from sensors, satellites and drones.
This project builds models that uncover hidden graph structures in data and work across different learning tasks.
This project uses microrobotics and machine learning to study how cells form patterns in tissue and to create a liver organoid.
This project studies how lithium niobate photonic devices can control laser light for trapped ion quantum computers.
This project studies how interferon signaling helps ovarian cancer cells enter a dormant state and evade chemotherapy.
This project installs an instrument that measures complex chemical mixtures and contaminants in water, soil and air.
This project studies behavior, including how genetics influences compulsive behaviors and the biological mechanisms of social behavior in rodents.
This project builds openly available software that uses artificial intelligence and physics to infer hidden properties of ice sheets from satellite and airborne measurements.
